lane: LAYERED-ON-REGISTERED (M-ALIGN wave-2) — apply the layered multi-pass style treatment (never before combined with the registered true-greybox path) to the REUSED tavern_fit2 registered base, to test whether it recovers the incumbent's LAYERED brushwork richness WHILE keeping registration.
verdict: HONEST NEGATIVE — do NOT adopt. The layered treatment recovers brushwork richness but CANNOT keep registration: the second heavy Gemini relight edit breaks the dimetric camera (p2) or relocates props (camera-locked p2b). No layered variant clears the incumbent band under corrected anchoring. promote.py --dry-run: passed=false, tier=null, control_valid=true (delta -3.0 < -2.5 adopt floor).
hypothesis_result: REFUTED for the all-Gemini layered chain. The two conjuncts cannot be held together: (a) the registration-SAFE pass (p1 material-only, STRUCTURE-LOCK) holds recall 0.9348 vs base AND enriches brushwork, but by the layered order-law it deliberately keeps lighting flat and so lacks the incumbent's dramatic staging -> panel 6.0; (b) the pass that adds the dramatic tenebrist staging (p2 lighting) REIMAGINES the scene -> dimetric camera lost (recall 0.93->0.63), and with a hard camera-lock retry (p2b) it holds the camera but RELOCATES the hearth (recall ->0.735). The incumbent keeps registration because ITS layered pipeline uses a LOW-STRENGTH z-image img2img base pass (strength 0.5-0.6, camera-pinned by construction) BEFORE the Gemini detail passes; an all-Gemini instruction-edit chain accumulates composition drift on the 2nd heavy edit.

reused_base.provenance: tavern_fit2 flux.1-dev depth-CN base from PR #1559 (model_bfl-flux-1-dev, cs0.95 seed222), reused NOT regenerated

p1_material.note: SWEET SPOT: composition perfectly locked to base (round tables, timber walls, camera, layout), visibly richer hand-painted material. Structure-locked material pass works.

p2_lighting.note: CATASTROPHIC REGISTRATION BREAK: tenebrism relight recomposed to a front-on eye-level view (dimetric camera LOST), raised the cutaway near-walls into full walls, INVENTED wall lanterns.

p2b_lighting_camera_locked_retry.note: packet-sanctioned retry-once with a HARD dimetric camera-lock: HELD the top-down dimetric camera but RELOCATED the hearth (back-center -> right) and round->rectangular tables. Milder break, still a break.

p3_scatter.note: richest brushwork of the set (real stone masonry, deep hearth-pool tenebrism, tabletop mugs/bottles) BUT built on the camera-broken p2 -> inherits the camera break; +1 net-new inverse-coherence flag (invented micro-object on authored-clear floor).

recall_trail_note: edge-recall vs base is ADVISORY for soft-edge painterly plates (#1491) — a painterly Gemini pass structurally scores ~0.75-0.81 (measured: single-pass s1111=0.81, s1000=0.75 vs base). The literal packet gate 'abort below 0.95 vs base' would abort EVERY paint pass by construction; the 0.95 masonry gate is on the BASE (met at 0.98). Per-pass styled recall tracked as advisory + relative no-drift; the real per-pass structural gate is inverse-coherence net-new==0. IMPORTANT: edge-recall UNDER-reports the camera break (p3 '0.805 vs greybox' is a fully-recomposed wrong-camera plate) because it is brightness-robust + tolerance-based and inflated by plate busy-ness. Visual inspection is ground truth.

inverse_coherence.caveat: the p2 '0 net-new' is MISLEADING — once the camera drifts off the contract dimetric projection, the detector projects grid cells onto the wrong pixels and silently under-reports. The IC check is only trustworthy when the plate is on-contract (base, p1). The p3 scatter pass reliably costs 1 ADDITIONS-LOCK flag (both seeds).

fit2_rescore_under_corrected_anchoring: YES — THE ANCHOR FIX MOVED IT. The fit2 single-pass was 6.0 / delta -3.0 under #1559's incumbent-as-house_best anchoring; under corrected neutral anchoring it is 7.0 / delta -1.0 — a +1.0 score gain and a +2.0 delta gain. The incumbent itself scored only 7.5 (delta -0.5), barely above the single-pass. So #1560 is CONFIRMED: the incumbent-as-house_best circularity was suppressing challenger deltas by ~2 points, and the #1559 honest-negative was SUBSTANTIALLY an anchor artifact — the fit2 single-pass sits only 0.5 below the incumbent and, at delta -1.0, within promote.py's parity band (>= -1.2) under neutral anchoring.

remaining_lever: With the layered lever REFUTED for the all-Gemini path, TRAINED PAINT FIDELITY (#1546) is the sole remaining lever to BEAT the incumbent's brushwork WHILE keeping registration. HOWEVER the corrected-anchoring re-score reframes the whole question: under neutral anchoring the fit2 single-pass (delta -1.0) is already at statistical parity with real PoE2 art and only 0.5 below the incumbent — the M-ALIGN 'gap to the incumbent' was largely an anchor artifact, not a craft deficit. A non-refuted intermediate lever also surfaced: reproduce the incumbent's OWN recipe on the registered path — a LOW-STRENGTH img2img (z-image+LoRA) base/detail pass (camera-pinned) rather than an all-Gemini chain — which is the mechanism that lets the incumbent be layered AND registered.
